conservative.requirements: A target within medium range generates a fear or terror effect while you have sufficient power (see below). Special: When a target within medium range generates a fear or terror effect, you may spend any amount of power. The severity rating of a fear effect is reduced by one for each point of power spent, and may be reduced to 0 (in which case it is ignored). The severity rating of a terror effect is reduced by one for every two points of power spent, and may be reduced to 0 (in which case it is ignored).
